title: WYNONNA JUDD – The Hard Truth Tour
seo_title: Wynonna Judd: The Hard Truth Tour in Springfield, MO
description: Country singer Wynonna Judd performs live in The Hard Truth Tour, with music from her recent, deeply personal work alongside her long career, which began with eight consecutive No. 1 hits as one half of The Judds. The concert takes place Friday, February 19, 2027 at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO. Tickets are sold officially only through HammonsHall.com and MissouriStateTix.co.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
